parsed.post: Discarded 0.8133. The jump from DEPTH 6 to 8 (0.8107) seems to have hit a local noise/instability. Reverting to the global best 0.8107 (cc0f8f3). Since depth 8 is sensitive, I'll try lowering the learning rate to 0.03 to stabilize the higher capacity model.
